introduce:
Start on all fours with your knees under your butt and your hands under your shoulders. Tuck your toes against the floor.

Inhale as you smoothly arch your back, sit your hips back, and lift your head toward the ceiling.

As you exhale, transition back to the starting position, curling your spine upward and naturally dropping your head.

Flatten the tops of your feet against the floor, engage your core, and shift your hips back as your arms lift until they align parallel with your thighs.

Repeat the flow with a steady rhythm.
name: CAT BACK FLOW

tips.text: Please prepare a mat.
Inhale as your back arches and exhale as you curl.
Engage your core to protect your spine and increase control.
Perform the flow slowly and with control.
Drop your head naturally to enhance spinal extension.
This exercise improves your spinal flexibility and core stability.
This exercise relieves your back, shoulders, and neck tension.

introduce:
Start on all fours with your hips lifted, forming an inverted V-shape. Keep your arms shoulder-width apart and your feet flat on the floor, aligned with your hips.

Exhale, lift your heels and bend your knees, bringing your chest towards your knees while keeping your arms straight. Inhale, straighten your legs and transition back to the inverted V-shape.

Lift your heels again, then bring your upper body towards your legs and arch your back.

Transition back to the starting position and repeat this sequence.
name: REVERSE BRIDGE

tips.text: Please prepare a mat.
Coordinate your breath with your flow.
Make sure there is enough distance between your hands and feet.
Press your hands firmly into the floor.
Engage your core to maintain stability.
Perform the flow slowly and with control.
Maintain the natural extension of your spine.
Don't strain your neck.
This exercise stretches your back, chest, and legs.
This exercise strengthens your core and enhances spinal flexibility.

introduce:
Start in an upright kneeling position with your knees hip-width apart and the tops of your feet flat on the floor.

Inhale, lean backward and arch your back while extending your arms upward in a graceful curve, following the line of your spine.

Exhale, curl your back, and sweep your arms downward and cross them on the mat, with your left arm extended underneath. Take your gaze to the left.

Curl your toes to press them firmly into the floor and lower your body to feel the stretch in your shoulders.

Transition back to the starting position and repeat on the other side.
name: ARCH AND CURL WITH SHOULDER STRETCH

tips.text: Please prepare a mat.
Coordinate your breath with the movement.
Fully open your chest and lengthen your spine as you raise your arms.
Follow the motion naturally with your gaze.
This exercise stretches your shoulders and strengthens your core.

introduce:
Start in a seated position with your legs together and extended forward.

Interlace your fingers and turn your palms outward. As you exhale, push your palms toward your feet with your insteps straightened. Inhale and lift your arms overhead, gently arching your back to open your chest.

Twist your torso to the left, bending your left knee and pointing your toes upward as you lower your hands. Place your right hand on the outside of your left knee and your left hand on the floor behind you for support. Take your gaze over your left shoulder.

Hold for a few seconds, then switch sides and repeat.
name: CURL BACK AND SPIRALING TWIST

tips.text: Please prepare a mat.
Exhale as you push your hands forward and inhale as you lift them.
Engage your core to stabilize your torso.
Straighten your insteps as you push forward, and point your toes upward as you twist.
Follow the motion naturally with your gaze.
Try to twist as far as possible to deepen the stretch.
This exercise increases your spinal flexibility.
This exercise enhances your core.

introduce:
Sit with your knees bent and feet flat on the floor, leaning back with your forearms supported on the floor.

Lift your right knee, and pause in the air, then bring it toward your chest.

Return to the starting position, and repeat on the other side.
name: BENT KNEE SINGLE LEG PUMP

tips.text: Please prepare a mat.
Engage your core to reduce pressure on your lower back.
Maintain steady breathing.
Avoid shrugging your shoulders.
Keep your elbows naturally bent to support your torso.
Perform the movement slowly and with control.
This exercise strengthens your core and legs.

introduce:
Sit with your legs extended forward, leaning back with your forearms supported on the floor. Lift your legs slightly.

Engage your core, and reach your left foot towards the ceiling while keeping your left leg straight. At the top, bring your knee towards your chest with your toes pointing forward.

Straighten your left leg, then switch legs and alternate this movement.
name: RECLINED BICYCLE

tips.text: Please prepare a mat.
Engage your core to stabilize your torso.
Maintain steady breathing.
Avoid shrugging your shoulders.
Keep your leg straight as your foot is towards the ceiling.
Keep your elbows naturally bent to support your torso.
Perform the movement slowly and with control.
This exercise strengthens your core and improves coordination.

introduce:
Lie on your left side with your forearm supported on the floor. Bend your knees, aligning your left leg under your hip.

Inhale, bring your right knee toward your chest. Exhale, engage your core, reaching your right foot back while lengthening your torso forward. Simultaneously, place your right hand on the floor in front of you for balance.

Return to the starting position and repeat with a smooth and steady rhythm.
name: LEFT LYING MERMAID KNEE TO CHEST

tips.text: Please prepare a mat.
Engage your core to stabilize your torso.
Place your elbow directly under your shoulder to reduce shoulder strain.
Exhale as you reach your leg back and inhale as you return.
Extend your leg and torso as far as possible with control.
This exercise strengthens your core, legs and glutes.

introduce:
Lie on your right side with your forearm supported on the floor. Bend your knees, aligning your right leg under your hip.

Inhale, bring your left knee toward your chest. Exhale, engage your core, reaching your left foot back while lengthening your torso forward. Simultaneously, place your left hand on the floor in front of you for balance.

Return to the starting position and repeat with a smooth and steady rhythm.
name: RIGHT LYING MERMAID KNEE TO CHEST

tips.text: Please prepare a mat.
Engage your core to stabilize your torso.
Place your elbow directly under your shoulder to reduce shoulder strain.
Exhale as you reach your leg back and inhale as you return.
Extend your leg and torso as far as possible with control.
This exercise strengthens your core, legs and glutes.

introduce:
Sit with your legs together and extended forward, leaning back with your forearms supported on the floor and lifting your legs slightly, keeping your insteps straight.

Inhale, engage your core and bring your knees toward your chest, then extend your legs upward with your toes pointing downward. Exhale, circle your legs to the left and back to the starting position.

Repeat on the other side with a steady rhythm.
name: DOUBLE LEG CIRCLES

tips.text: Please prepare a mat.
Engage your core to stabilize your torso.
Avoid shrugging your shoulders.
Keep your elbows naturally bent.
Inhale as you bring your legs toward your chest, and exhale as you lower them.
Perform this movement slowly and with control.
Always keep your legs together and off the floor.
This exercise effectively strengthens your core.

introduce:
Sit with your knees open to the sides and the soles of your feet together. Hold your feet with your hands and lean forward to stretch your inner thighs.

Next, extend your right leg to the side with your hands on your knees and tilt your torso to the right to deepen the stretch. Bring your leg back, and switch sides to stretch your left leg.

Then, bring your left leg back and lean forward again. Extend your legs to the sides and bend your torso forward with your hands on the floor.

Return to the starting position and repeat this sequence.
name: LEG STRETCH FLOW

tips.text: Please prepare a mat.
Maintain steady breathing.
This exercise stretches your adductors and hamstrings.

introduce:
Sit cross-legged with your eyes closed, back straight, chest up, and hands resting naturally at your sides.

Take a deep breath, sweep your hands from the sides up to the top of your head and stack them. Breathe out deeply and lower your hands to your navel.

Take a few deep breaths in and out, feeling the flow of energy and calmness within your body.
name: BACK TO CENTER

tips.text: Please prepare a mat.
Always keep your chest up and your back straight.
Inhale and exhale deeply throughout the process.
Feel the flow of your breath and inner energy.
This exercise helps release tension and stress.
This exercise enhances awareness of your body's energy flow.
